introAudioPlan.sourceSelection: Use the same source intervals and speed factors selected by the v6 actual-footage audit; no stock or prototype recording substituted for original Buckshot gameplay.
introAudioPlan.speedHandling: Apply pitch-preserving atempo to each source-audio interval using the same factor as the picture: 4x => atempo=2,atempo=2; 3x => atempo=1.5,atempo=2. Never accelerate only picture while leaving its sounds on the old timeline; do not use asetrate pitch shifting.
introAudioPlan.loudness: Measure the exact accelerated edit. Begin toward the established original-audio -23 LUFS profile with per-cut transient headroom; inspect shots and impacts so the first seconds do not jump in volume.
introAudioPlan.sourceMusicLimitation: Original Buckshot game mix may contain its own music; it is not an isolated effects stem. Preserve identifiable original effects, lower added Nimbus by the established -3 dB overlap rule, and document the actual source mix rather than claiming a clean music removal.

recommendedAssembly: Independently decode all segments to float 48 kHz stereo. Concatenate branding -> 30-second accelerated actual-game audio -> unchanged body-mix.wav -> membership; sample-count the output.

Build one continuous Nimbus bed using static -15.67 dB source gain, one-second crossfade repeat, exact trim and overall 0.45-second fades. Smooth additional -3 dB attenuation across actual/prototype source-audio spans, including the intro.

Derive only the sidechain from unchanged narration.wav with its +3.5 dB gain, 48 kHz resample, original exact body pad/trim and 32-second delay. Duck the music, not the base mix; no second source-audio ducking.
Sum base + ducked music with amix normalize=0 and no extra narration normalization, preserving float headroom.

Use the existing single final limiter/encoder pattern: aresample=192000,alimiter=limit=0.794328:level=false:latency=true,aresample=48000, then one AAC 192 kbps stereo encode. Lower only if actual encoded true peak exceeds -1.5 dBTP.
Packet-copy the same final AAC into clean and captioned masters and verify identical decoded audio/timestamps and exact total duration.
